blocks.text: Yeh woh halatein hain jin mein dimagh, spinal cord ya peripheral nerves ke nerve cells ka zawal (deterioration) barhta jata hai. Misalein: Parkinson's disease (dimagh ke dopamine banane wale neurons ka barhta hua marna ya kamzor hona, jis se harkat ke masail aur soch mein tabdeeliyan aati hain), Huntington's disease (dimagh ke neurons ka barhta nuqsan, jis se harkat ki bimariyan, soch ka zawal aur nafsiyati alamaat aati hain), multiple sclerosis (CNS ki autoimmune bimari, yaani jism ka apna immune system hamla karta hai, jis mein myelin sheath kharab hoti hai aur nazar ka jana, dard, thakan aur kamzor coordination hota hai), aur Alzheimer's disease.

Alzheimer's disease dimagh ki barhti hui degenerative bimari hai jo yaad dasht, soch aur rawayye ko mutasir karti hai. Yeh bari umar ke logon mein dementia (yaad aur soch ki kamzori) ka sabab banti hai. Yeh aam taur par boorhe logon mein shuru hoti hai, lekin kitab ke mutabiq yeh khaas taur par budhape se juri hui nahin. Wajahein: yeh jeeni (genetic), mahol aur tarz-e-zindagi ke asbab ke majmooe se hoti hai. Alamaat aam taur par halki bhool aur uljhan se shuru ho kar soch ki shadeed kharabi tak barhti hain, jis mein zaban, masle hal karne aur jaane pehchane kaam karne mein mushkil shamil hai. Ilaj: Alzheimer's ka koi ilaj (cure) nahin, lekin aisi dawayein hain jo is ki raftar kam karti hain aur yaad dasht aur soch ko behtar karti hain.

blocks.title: Matan ke baare mein
blocks.text: Kitab kehti hai Alzheimer's aam taur par bare umar walon mein shuru hota hai 'magar khaas taur par budhape se juda nahin'. Dar asal umar sab se bara maloom khatra hai, agarche yeh bimari budhape ka naarmal hissa nahin.

blocks.prompt: Parkinson's disease mein kaun sa neurotransmitter shamil hai?
blocks.explanation: Dopamine: use banane wale neurons marte ya kamzor hote hain.

items: Degenerative bimariyan: Parkinson's (dopamine neurons), Huntington's, multiple sclerosis (myelin, autoimmune), Alzheimer's (yaad, dementia; cure nahin, dawayein raftar kam karti hain).
